about: The world box, [min, max] in metres, of what src/ship.js drew for each thing the ship pack replaces, measured once with Box3.setFromObject(obj, true) off ship.js at db06e5f, the commit before B4, with buildWorld() run into a bare Scene. console, seat and bed are their groups; pipes the four 5.6 m cylinders as one box; tray the body and soil, not the plant group; hatch-inner the hatch and its header; hull the body, hump, dish and both pods, not the engine glows; panel one box a system in systems.json order, satellite one a POI in poi.json order, at the POI group's build-time rotation. The builders are gone, so these numbers are the record of them. test/ship.mjs holds every corner to 2 cm (#697).
